Here is the secure variable input box. Paste only the **Supabase Management API token** (`sbp_...`) — do not paste the publishable or secret project keys. I’ll use it to update Render’s `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` env var and verify it live.

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN                                  │
│  [ paste your new sbp_... token here ]                   │
│                                                         │
│  ⚠️ Only Management API token. Not sb_publish / sb_secret.│
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Use the secure env input panel below to send it.
